harnessSource:
"""Rule-6 mutants for syzygy-bpyt.6.2's shared non-human-principal rule.

Each mutant rewrites exact fragments of the subject files, runs both gates'
suites, restores the bytes and verifies their digest. A mutant is killed
when at least one test fails. Usage: python3 act_fields_mutants.py <worktree> <out.json>
"""
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1])
OUT = Path(sys.argv[2])
FIELDS = 'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/act-fields.ts'
BODY = 'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/body-read-authority.ts'
JUDGMENT = 'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/walkthrough-judgment.ts'
TESTS = [
    'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/body-read-authority.test.ts',
    'packages/three-surface-poc-core/src/walkthrough-judgment.test.ts',
]
RULE = (
    r"/^(agent|bot|machine|service|system|ci|pipeline|model)([:\s-]|$)|\b(claude|codex|gpt|copilot|llm)\b|"
    r"^(?:agent|bot|ci|system|daemon|service|pipeline|automation|model|claude|syzygy)(?:[\s:/-]|$)|(?:\[bot\]|-bot|-agent)$/i;"
)
ARM1 = r"^(agent|bot|machine|service|system|ci|pipeline|model)([:\s-]|$)|"
ARM2 = r"\b(claude|codex|gpt|copilot|llm)\b|"
ARM3 = r"^(?:agent|bot|ci|system|daemon|service|pipeline|automation|model|claude|syzygy)(?:[\s:/-]|$)|"
ARM4 = r"|(?:\[bot\]|-bot|-agent)$/i;"
OLD_BODY_RULE = r"/^(agent|bot|machine|service|system|ci|pipeline|model)([:\s-]|$)|\b(claude|codex|gpt|copilot|llm)\b/i"
OLD_JUDGMENT_RULE = r"/^(?:agent|bot|ci|system|daemon|service|pipeline|automation|model|claude|syzygy)(?:[\s:/-]|$)|(?:\[bot\]|-bot|-agent)$/i"


def rule_with(old, new):
    assert RULE.count(old) == 1, old
    return [(FIELDS, RULE, RULE.replace(old, new))]


MUTANTS = [
    ('drop-arm-1-role-prefix', 'the former body-read role-prefix arm is removed', rule_with(ARM1, '')),
    ('drop-arm-2-model-name', 'the former body-read model-name arm is removed', rule_with(ARM2, '')),
    ('drop-arm-3-role-prefix', 'the former judgment role-prefix arm is removed', rule_with(ARM3, '')),
    ('drop-arm-4-suffix', 'the former judgment bot/agent suffix arm is removed', rule_with(ARM4, '/i;')),
    ('arm-1-unanchored', 'the arm-1 role prefix matches anywhere, not at the start', rule_with(r"/^(agent|bot|machine", r"/(agent|bot|machine")),
    ('arm-1-no-separator', 'the arm-1 role prefix needs no separator after it', rule_with(r"model)([:\s-]|$)|", r"model)|")),
    ('arm-2-no-word-boundary', 'the model-name arm matches inside a word', rule_with(r"\b(claude|codex|gpt|copilot|llm)\b", r"(claude|codex|gpt|copilot|llm)")),
    ('arm-3-unanchored', 'the arm-3 role prefix matches anywhere, not at the start', rule_with(r"|^(?:agent|bot|ci|system|daemon", r"|(?:agent|bot|ci|system|daemon")),
    ('arm-3-no-slash', 'the arm-3 separator class loses the slash', rule_with(r"(?:[\s:/-]|$)", r"(?:[\s:-]|$)")),
    ('arm-4-unanchored', 'the suffix arm matches anywhere, not at the end', rule_with(r"(?:\[bot\]|-bot|-agent)$/i", r"(?:\[bot\]|-bot|-agent)/i")),
    ('case-sensitive', 'the rule loses its case-insensitive flag', rule_with(r"-agent)$/i;", r"-agent)$/;")),
    (
        'body-gate-private-former-rule',
        'the body-read gate tests owners against its former private rule again',
        [
            (BODY, 'const REPOSITORY_IDENTITY = ', f'const FORMER_NON_HUMAN = {OLD_BODY_RULE};\nconst REPOSITORY_IDENTITY = '),
            (BODY, 'NON_HUMAN_PRINCIPAL.test(', 'FORMER_NON_HUMAN.test('),
        ],
    ),
    (
        'judgment-gate-private-former-rule',
        'the judgment evaluator tests owners against its former private rule again',
        [
            (JUDGMENT, 'const RUN_RECORD_IDENTITY = ', f'const FORMER_NON_HUMAN = {OLD_JUDGMENT_RULE};\nconst RUN_RECORD_IDENTITY = '),
            (JUDGMENT, 'NON_HUMAN_PRINCIPAL.test(', 'FORMER_NON_HUMAN.test('),
        ],
    ),
]


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), *args], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def run_tests(scratch, label):
    out = Path(scratch) / f'{label}.json'
    subprocess.run(
        ['npx', 'vitest', 'run', '--project', '@syzygy/three-surface-poc-core', *TESTS, '--reporter=json', f'--outputFile={out}'],
        cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, env={**__import__('os').environ, 'CI': '1'},
    )
    report = json.loads(out.read_text())
    failing = [t['fullName'] for f in report['testResults'] for t in f['assertionResults'] if t['status'] == 'failed']
    return {'total': report['numTotalTests'], 'passed': report['numPassedTests'], 'failed': report['numFailedTests']}, failing


def main():
    subjects = [FIELDS, BODY, JUDGMENT]
    dirty_before = git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no')
    originals = {f: (ROOT / f).read_bytes() for f in subjects}
    results = []
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
        baseline, baseline_failing = run_tests(scratch, 'baseline')
        try:
            for mutant_id, description, edits in MUTANTS:
                texts = {f: originals[f].decode('utf-8') for f in subjects}
                fragments = []
                for path, old, new in edits:
                    assert texts[path].count(old) == 1, (mutant_id, path, old)
                    texts[path] = texts[path].replace(old, new)
                    fragments.append({'file': path, 'old': old, 'new': new})
                for path in {e[0] for e in edits}:
                    (ROOT / path).write_bytes(texts[path].encode('utf-8'))
                try:
                    observed, failing = run_tests(scratch, mutant_id)
                finally:
                    for path in subjects:
                        (ROOT / path).write_bytes(originals[path])
                restored = all(sha((ROOT / f).read_bytes()) == sha(originals[f]) for f in subjects)
                results.append({
                    'id': mutant_id, 'description': description, 'fragments': fragments,
                    'observed': observed, 'failing': failing, 'killed': len(failing) > 0, 'restored': restored,
                })
                print(mutant_id, 'killed' if failing else 'SURVIVED', len(failing), flush=True)
        finally:
            for path in subjects:
                (ROOT / path).write_bytes(originals[path])
    record = {
        'subject': 'syzygy-bpyt.6.2 shared non-human-principal rule and its two importing gates',
        'commit': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD').strip(),
        'trackedTreeDirtyBefore': dirty_before.splitlines(),
        'trackedTreeDirtyAfter': git('status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=no').splitlines(),
        'subjectDigests': {f: sha(originals[f]) for f in subjects},
        'testFiles': TESTS,
        'baseline': {**baseline, 'failing': baseline_failing},
        'mutants': results,
        'summary': {'planned': len(MUTANTS), 'killed': sum(r['killed'] for r in results), 'restored': sum(r['restored'] for r in results)},
        'harnessSource': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    }
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('summary', record['summary'])


main()
